before.requirement: Avoid releasing a terminal orphan comment twice when the parser is destroyed.
before.reason: The terminal path releases the comment, but the complete old destructor does not release last_comment.

after.requirement: Avoid releasing a terminal orphan comment twice when the parser is destroyed.
after.reason: The terminal path clears last_comment after releasing it; the new destructor releases it only when the pointer remains set.

claims.reason: The same old harness parses once and then conditionally destroys the parser. Neither source version performs a second release in the frozen sequence. Coverage remains incomplete because the supplied focus limits this assessment to that claim.
